title: 🦶 cut toenails
steps: 1. Trim nails per the nails routine — clip straight, file edges, clean the clipper.
done_when:
- Toes trimmed straight; edges filed smooth
- No sharp corners catching socks; clipper cleaned and dry
summary: Trim nails per the nails routine — clip straight, file edges, clean the clipper.

title: 🦷 dentist
steps:
1. Book the dentist per the providers routine.
2. Attend; note next recommended interval.
done_when: - Appointment completed; next visit in calendar
summary: Book the dentist per the providers routine.

title: 💇 haircut
steps: 1. Book the barber per the providers routine — thick, curvy hair, trim to eyebrow height, scissors only.
done_when: - Cut done; next visit scheduled if needed

title: 🩺 health exams
steps:
1. Book the lab appointment per the providers routine (fasting if required).
2. Attend; collect results when ready; file or note abnormal flags for follow-up.
done_when: - Blood draw done; results reviewed or filed
summary: Book the lab appointment per the providers routine (fasting if required).

title: 💊 pharmacy restock
steps: 1. Restock per the pharmacy plan — buy the 4 wk column, skip rows on shelf, check on-hand meds lifespan.
done_when:
- Monthly restock covers ~30 days (or shelf already full)
- On-hand meds checked; none past lifespan
- Receipt prices updated on the buy plan

title: 🪒 shave
steps: 1. Shave per the shave routine — all zones, rinse between, clean tools after.
done_when:
- Shave zones done; tools rinsed, dry, stored
- No nicks, ingrown risk, or dull-blade drag left unaddressed
summary: Shave per the shave routine — all zones, rinse between, clean tools after.

title: 💉 flu vaccine
steps:
1. Get the flu vaccine per the providers routine.
2. Keep receipt or card if offered.
summary: Get the flu vaccine per the providers routine.

title: ⚖️ weigh-in
steps:
1. Weigh in — same conditions (morning, before eating), same scale.
2. Record weight in diet status; refresh intake/deficit if anything drifted.
done_when:
- Weight recorded; status tables reflect reality
- Deficit/time-to-goal recomputed if anything moved
summary: Weigh in — same conditions (morning, before eating), same scale.
